title: Momentum bridge 1:1 brief - Jamal Haddad
body:
Meeting goal: Align on priorities for the next sprint, unblock rollout of KV cache profiles, and talk through career growth options.

Meeting logistics:
- Length: 30m (tight)
- When: 2026-04-11 10:30am PT
- Context: weekly cadenced sync, but this one focused on momentum after on-call and the canary regressions last week.

Quick wins / wins to call out:
- Deployed canary for r14 kernels; observed 12% median p95 improvement on short sequences.
- You led incident postmortem well; cross-team notes were thorough.

Topics I want to cover (prioritized):
1) KV cache regressions and rollout plan (15m)
   - Current state: canary shows improved latency but increased token-miss rate for long-context sessions.
   - Hypothesis: kernel fallback logic misaligned with quantized variants.
   - Ask from you: validate RWI-2376 repro steps and sign off on rollback criteria.
   - Links: Linear RWI-2376; PR #842. 
2) Career trajectory checkpoints & promotion readiness (7m)
   - Evidence: ownership of kernel selection logic + mentorship of SRE interns.
   - Areas to strengthen: cross-team influence, doc triage ownership (ship clearer migration docs).
   - Next step: prepare a 1-2 bullet draft for promotion packet by Apr 20. 
3) Capacity/cost tradeoffs for Dedicated trials (5m)
   - Quick ask: can we apply A/B routing policy in test region for 2 weeks? Need your help to prioritize with infra.

Blockers / help needed:
- CI flakiness on nightly quantization tests (flake rate ~8%). I've reduced matrix but need SRE time to look.
- Need clarity on who will own Drafting the migration playbook for customers using pinned model versions.

Coaching prompts (for me to practice):
- Ask open question: "What would you change about the rollout if you could start over?"
- Listen for signals of bandwidth stretch; offer to re-align priorities.
- Avoid jumping to solutions; confirm with summary before suggesting.

Tentative action items (to confirm during meeting):
- Jamal: reproduce token-miss with synthetic long context and document exact kernel fallback events. Due: 2026-04-13.
- Jamal + Asha: triage CI flakes and open a short-lived ticket with SRE for 2-day investigation. Due: 2026-04-14.
- Manager: escalate need for routing experiment in test region to infra and mark priority 'P2' for two-week window. Due: 2026-04-12.
- Jamal: draft 2 bullets for promotion packet and share by Apr 20. Due: 2026-04-20.
- Manager: sync with product-hosted-api on customer migration playbook owners. Due: 2026-04-16.

Notes-to-self (private):
- Praise: highlight how Jamal handled stakeholder comms after canary.
- Dont: turn career convo into a task list; keep it aspirational.
- Follow-up cadence: Quick async check-in 48h after this 1:1.

Post-meeting follow-up template (to use after meeting):
- TL;DR of decisions (2 lines)
- Action items (list with owner + due date)
- Raised risks (if any) and next checkpoint date

Slack anchors / refs:
- #runtime-kernel: thread id 4672
- #infra-rollouts: pinned note "canary-2026-04"

Scratch snippets / questions to remember:
- "If rolling back, is there a perf vs. correctness window we can accept temporarily?"
- "Who else should be looped in for migration docs—solutions-eng or product-ops?"

End.
